label: Entner-Doudoroff pathway, glucose-6P => glyceraldehyde-3P + pyruvate
status: Feasible complete-route lead for separate curation, not authored or approved.
full_boundary: Four transformations from glucose 6-phosphate to D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate and pyruvate: oxidation, lactone hydrolysis, dehydration, aldol cleavage. Import, gluconate kinase, downstream GAP glycolysis and fermentation are outside this exact module.
mapping_limit: The selected current E. coli Zwf annotation/Rhea15842 uses generic D-glucose 6-phosphate, whereas KEGG R02736 lead names beta-D-glucose 6-phosphate. Do not assert an exact compound mapping without separately checking original KEGG C01172/R02736/R10907 and the relevant ChEBI structures. This preflight verifies route boundary and a coherent enzyme-supported generic equation projection, not exact cross-source equivalence.

native_comparison.label: Entner-Doudoroff shunt
native_comparison.disposition: Complete independently named two-step shunt, not an incomplete copy of M00008; usable alternative identity only if this narrower native boundary is explicitly selected. It is not an exactMatch to the four-step module.

go_disposition: GO0061678 is active but intentionally spans phosphorylative and nonphosphorylative variants; GO0009255 is obsolete. Prefer exact KEGG or exact native scope, not an obsolete or overbroad GO identity.
brenda_disposition: Prior canary is a broad 15-reaction map with unresolved assertion-specific protein context; retain only as discovery support, not native route definition or duplicated maintained pathway.

protein_leads.activity_scope: Current catalytic annotation ECO0000255/HAMAP; PMID1704005 abstract/metadata retained, scanned full paper not inspected.
